article_published_complete.name: article_published_complete
article_published_complete.value: "article"."status" <> 'published' or ("article"."title" is not null and "article"."body_html" is not null and "article"."cover_url" is not null and "article"."slug" is not null and "article"."published_at" is not null)

article_in_review_complete.name: article_in_review_complete
article_in_review_complete.value: "article"."status" <> 'in_review' or ("article"."title" is not null and "article"."body_html" is not null and "article"."cover_url" is not null and "article"."submitted_at" is not null)

membership_payment_paid_complete.name: membership_payment_paid_complete
membership_payment_paid_complete.value: "membership_payment"."status" <> 'paid' or ("membership_payment"."paid_at" is not null and "membership_payment"."period_end" is not null)
